answer: Identity creation costs real tokens, so forging thousands of sybils means locking a fortune at the mesa's edge, while honest agents recover stake after proving unique work. Each new agent must burn a copper-denominated stake locked for one epoch, painted in umber on the registry ledger. Attackers pay more than they can profit, and the network's ledger stays clean. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
